name: The Leader Checkup
unit: one leader and the people who report to them
columns: Blocking — when you X, we Y

flow.does: One keep, one block, one ask; the leader writes a self-critique too
Round robin; the leader does not defend
The leader says what they heard and asks one question
One concrete change with a follow-up date

commitment: Reflect back — what I actually heard
The one thing I will not defend, and why it was hard
Follow-up date — and what the team will watch for
debrief_prompts: Leader: what did you hear that genuinely surprised you?
Leader: where did you feel the pull to defend?
Team: did it feel safe to be honest — what made it safer?
Team: did the leader listen, or wait to respond?
Both: what exactly will be different, and how will we all know?
Both: who owns the follow-up date, and what happens if it slips?
watch_outs: The leader starts defending — park explanations until after.
The team gives only “everything’s great” — the leader opens with a real self-critique.
A block becomes a character attack — reframe to behaviour plus impact.
note: No pre/post measure in this folder: the artifact is the point. Hand this spec to an agent to render a fillable sheet or a live form.
